subject: Mid-cycle leadership readout: narrow scope + unblock requests
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Mid-cycle leadership readout: narrow scope + unblock requests

Team —

As we approach the mid-window readout for Q3, I want a concise leadership snapshot we can use in the QBR. High-level asks below — please keep updates to a single slide each (slide template in the Drive link). Im intentionally narrowing scope to the items that materially affect runway or FY revenue so we can present crisp tradeoffs.

Priority list (please action before Monday EOD):
- One-slide status per initiative (progress, next milestone, 2 blockers) — owners: Vanessa, Naomi, Karthik, Laura
- Update the dependency matrix (see attached) with current ETA and the single strongest mitigation for each unblock
- Flag any customer-facing risk we should pre-announce (Brightware is sensitive to latencies on embeddings)

Specific asks:
- Vanessa: verify Dedicated capacity forecast for Sept (are we on the 4x throughput plan or do we need to hold to 3x?)
- Naomi: finalize the compliance gating list for the private deployment offer; highlight anything that would change the go/no-go for the top three pilot customers
- Karthik: short note on infra headroom and whether autoscaling policy needs a temporary bump for the next two weeks
- Laura: include current SLAs promised to Brightware and a short plan if we need to renegotiate SLOs

Attachments: QBR_slide_draft_v1.pptx, dependency_matrix.xlsx, SLA_signal_request.docx. Link to folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBRDeckDraft

I will collate slides and circulate a consolidated leadership note by Tuesday morning so we can circulate to execs and the Brightware account team. If you see risks that require immediate exec attention, call me first.

Thanks,

Markus Klein
VP, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle leadership readout: narrow scope + unblock requests

Markus —

Quick updates and slide plan (I attached a one-slide PDF extract so you can review the language).

- Dedicated capacity forecast: current booking covers baseline 3x throughput. Theres an 8% shortfall vs. projected demand for mid-September burst windows when Brightware runs indexing jobs. We can achieve 4x if we approve a short-term bump to the reserved pool (~2 additional A100 instances) by next Tues; ops estimates deployment ~48 hours after approval.
- Customer risk: Brightware trial includes high-rate embedding calls. If we don't bump capacity, they may see 95th pct latency increases to ~650ms for 2-3 hour windows; SLA threshold sits at 500ms.
- Mitigations: temporary burst pool + prefixed KV caching for the Brightware job. I marked both in dependency_matrix.xlsx with owner and ETA.

Attachments: QBR_slide_draft_v1.pptx (updated slide page 4), dependency_matrix.xlsx (rows 6-9 updated).

I'll sync with infra ops after lunch to confirm node availability.

- Vanessa
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Mid-cycle leadership readout: narrow scope + unblock requests

Folks —

Compliance gating update (short):

- Private deployment checklist: SOC2 evidence and KMS integration mostly green; remaining items: encryption key rotation proof (customer audit request) and additional network ACL confirmation for Brightware's VPC peering. Estimated time to produce artifacts: 5 business days if we prioritize (Im assuming legal signs off on the standard addendum).
- Risk: If the key rotation evidence isn't in place before Brightware pilot, they will request a delayed pilot or stricter scoping (only non-sensitive embedding pipelines). That would remove ~20% of expected ARR from the initial pilot cohort.

Dependency asks for leadership note:
1) Procurement approval for temporary capacity bump (Vanessas estimate). We need exec sign-off to commit spend this week.
2) Legal: fast-track the addendum for Brightware (I'll ping Legal).
3) Infra: confirm we can deliver required KMS logs to satisfy rotation evidence (Karthik).

I added these items into SLA_signal_request.docx and flagged high-impact ones in dependency_matrix.xlsx.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Platform & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@brightware.ai>, Roland Chu <rchu@brightware.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Mid-cycle leadership readout: narrow scope + unblock requests

Sarah / Roland —

Forwarding our internal mid-cycle readout. Short version for Brightware: we are prioritizing stability for your embedding workload and have two asks that may affect timelines:

1) We anticipate a short-term capacity bump request (2 A100-equivalent nodes) to avoid latency spikes during heavy indexing windows. This is an internal spend ask; well advise you if it impacts committed pricing but goal is to avoid any SLO change.
2) Compliance artifacts: were finishing key rotation logs and VPC ACL confirmations that Brightware requested. If you prefer to scope the pilot to non-sensitive pipelines while we finish, please let us know — thats a straightforward option that reduces initial risk.

Can you confirm whether the pilot can accept a scoped start (non-sensitive embeddings) or if you require full rail compliance at kickoff? Your answer will guide our exec sign-off and whether we proceed with the reserved capacity bump.

Appreciate a quick reply — if it helps, we can schedule a 30-min sync Wed morning.

Best,

Markus
VP, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: SLA_signal_request.docx]

Markus —

Thanks for looping them in. Sarah/Roland: we can scope the pilot to non-sensitive embeddings to start and still deliver meaningful signals for model ranking and search. That path preserves Brightwares timeline and reduces the compliance burden. If youre comfortable with that, we will pause the capacity bump approval until you confirm you want a full-compliance pilot.

Action: Sarah, please confirm scope by EOD Wed; Roland, if procurement will need a new addendum I can prep language with Legal.

Vanessa

Redwood Inference
